newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN to start repatriating Rwandans from Congo.
newsitem.headline: UN to start repatriating Rwandans from Congo.

text.p: The United Nations said on Friday it would start repatriating the first of up to 20,000 Rwandan refugees in Congo-Brazzaville at the weekend.
Some 88 Hutu refugees are expected to be flown to Kigali on Saturday from Loukolela, Congo, which holds some 7,000 of the estimated 18,000-20,000 Rwandans in the country.

"It is the only place where we are able to operate so far in the country because of the continuing conflict," Fernando del Mundo, spokesman for the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), told a news briefing in Geneva.

The agency was trying to bring Rwandan refugees scattered in several places in the Congo to Loukolela, located some 400 km (250 miles) north of Brazzaville along the border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the spokesman.
